0:
debug: false
main:
    name: BirdNET-Go
    timeas24h: true
    log:
        enabled: true
        path: birdnet.log
        rotation: daily
        maxsize: 1048576
        rotationday: Sunday
birdnet:
    sensitivity: 1
    threshold: 0.8
    overlap: 1.5
    longitude: ${HOUSE_LONGITUDE}
    latitude: ${HOUSE_LATITUDE}
    threads: 0
    locale: en
    rangefilter:
        model: latest
        threshold: 0.01
    modelpath: ""
    labelpath: ""
    usexnnpack: false
realtime:
    interval: 15
    processingtime: false
    audio:
        source: sysdefault
        ffmpegpath: ffmpeg
        soxpath: sox
        export:
            debug: false
            enabled: true
            path: /clips/
            type: wav
            bitrate: 96k
            retention:
                debug: false
                policy: usage
                maxage: 365d
        equalizer:
            enabled: false
            filters:
                - type: HighPass
                  frequency: 100
                  q: 0
                  gain: 0
                  width: 0
                  passes: 0
                - type: LowPass
                  frequency: 15000
                  q: 0
                  gain: 0
                  width: 0
                  passes: 0
    dashboard:
        thumbnails:
            debug: false
            summary: true
            recent: true
        summarylimit: 30
    dynamicthreshold:
        enabled: true
        debug: false
        trigger: 0.9
        min: 0.2
        validhours: 24
    log:
        enabled: true
        path: birdnet.txt
    birdweather:
        enabled: false
        debug: false
        id: ""
        threshold: 0.8
        locationaccuracy: 500
    openweather:
        enabled: false
        debug: false
        apikey: ""
        endpoint: https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather
        interval: 60
        units: metric
        language: en
    privacyfilter:
        debug: false
        enabled: true
        confidence: 0.05
    dogbarkfilter:
        debug: false
        enabled: true
        confidence: 0.1
        remember: 5
        species: []
    rtsp:
        transport: tcp
        urls:
            - rtsp://scrypted.home-automation.svc.cluster.local:34135/257656a9151ff8d4
    mqtt:
        enabled: true
        broker: tcp://mosquitto:1883
        topic: birdnet
    telemetry:
        enabled: true
        listen: 0.0.0.0:8090
    species:
        threshold: {}
        actions: {}
        include: []
        exclude: []
webserver:
    enabled: true
    port: "8080"
    log:
        enabled: false
        path: webui.log
        rotation: daily
        maxsize: 1048576
        rotationday: "0"
security:
    host: "https://birdnet.franta.us"
    autotls: false
    redirecttohttps: false
    allowsubnetbypass:
        enabled: false
        subnet: ""
    allowcloudflarebypass:
        enabled: false
        teamdomain: ""
        audience: ""
    basicauth:
        enabled: false
        password: ""
        clientid: ""
        clientsecret: "{{ .BASIC_AUTH_CLIENT_SECRET }}"
        redirecturi: ""
        authcodeexp: 10m0s
        accesstokenexp: 1h0m0s
    googleauth:
        enabled: false
        clientid: ""
        clientsecret: ""
        redirecturi: /settings
        userid: ""
    githubauth:
        enabled: false
        clientid: ""
        clientsecret: ""
        redirecturi: /settings
        userid: ""
    sessionsecret: ""
output:
    file: {}
    sqlite:
        enabled: true
        path: birdnet.db
    mysql:
        enabled: false
        username: birdnet
        password: secret
        database: birdnet
        host: localhost
        port: "3306"

mqtt:
  server: tcp://mosquitto.home-automation.svc.cluster.local:1883
  client_id: mqtt2prometheus
  qos: 0
  topic_path: solar_assistant/+/+/state
  device_id_regex: "solar_assistant/(?P<deviceid>[^/]+)/"
  metric_per_topic_config:
    metric_name_regex: "solar_assistant/[^/]+/(?P<metricname>[^/]+)/state"
cache:
  timeout: 5m
metrics:
  # battery_1 and total
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_battery_state_of_charge_percent
    mqtt_name: state_of_charge
    help: Battery state of charge
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_battery_voltage_volts
    mqtt_name: voltage
    help: Battery voltage
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_battery_current_amps
    mqtt_name: current
    help: Battery current (positive = charging)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_battery_power_watts
    mqtt_name: power
    help: Battery power (positive = charging)
    type: gauge
  # both battery_1 and inverter_1 publish a bare "temperature" topic,
  # so this one is named generically and the sensor label tells them apart
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_temperature_fahrenheit
    mqtt_name: temperature
    help: Device temperature as reported, see the sensor label (Fahrenheit)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_battery_capacity_amp_hours
    mqtt_name: capacity
    help: Battery capacity
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_total_battery_power_watts
    mqtt_name: battery_power
    help: Total battery power (positive = charging)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_total_battery_state_of_charge_percent
    mqtt_name: battery_state_of_charge
    help: Total battery state of charge
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_total_battery_temperature_fahrenheit
    mqtt_name: battery_temperature
    help: Total battery temperature (Fahrenheit)
    type: gauge
  # inverter_1 live values
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_ac_output_power_watts
    mqtt_name: ac_output_power
    help: Inverter AC output power
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_ac_output_voltage_volts
    mqtt_name: ac_output_voltage
    help: Inverter AC output voltage (L1+L2)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_ac_output_voltage_l1_volts
    mqtt_name: ac_output_voltage_1
    help: Inverter AC output voltage L1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_ac_output_voltage_l2_volts
    mqtt_name: ac_output_voltage_2
    help: Inverter AC output voltage L2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_ac_output_frequency_hertz
    mqtt_name: ac_output_frequency
    help: Inverter AC output frequency
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_battery_voltage_volts
    mqtt_name: battery_voltage
    help: Battery voltage as seen by the inverter
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_battery_current_amps
    mqtt_name: battery_current
    help: Battery current as seen by the inverter
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_power_watts
    mqtt_name: grid_power
    help: Grid power (positive = importing)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_power_l1_watts
    mqtt_name: grid_power_ld_1
    help: Grid power L1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_power_l2_watts
    mqtt_name: grid_power_ld_2
    help: Grid power L2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_ct_power_watts
    mqtt_name: grid_power_ct
    help: Grid power measured by the external CTs
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_voltage_volts
    mqtt_name: grid_voltage
    help: Grid voltage (L1+L2)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_voltage_l1_volts
    mqtt_name: grid_voltage_1
    help: Grid voltage L1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_voltage_l2_volts
    mqtt_name: grid_voltage_2
    help: Grid voltage L2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_grid_frequency_hertz
    mqtt_name: grid_frequency
    help: Grid frequency
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_load_power_watts
    mqtt_name: load_power
    help: Total load power
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_load_power_essential_watts
    mqtt_name: load_power_essential
    help: Essential (backed-up) load power
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_load_power_non_essential_watts
    mqtt_name: load_power_non-essential
    help: Non-essential load power
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_load_percent
    mqtt_name: load_percentage
    help: Load as a percentage of inverter capacity
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_power_watts
    mqtt_name: pv_power
    help: Total PV power
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_power_string1_watts
    mqtt_name: pv_power_1
    help: PV power, string 1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_power_string2_watts
    mqtt_name: pv_power_2
    help: PV power, string 2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_power_string3_watts
    mqtt_name: pv_power_3
    help: PV power, string 3
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_voltage_string1_volts
    mqtt_name: pv_voltage_1
    help: PV voltage, string 1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_voltage_string2_volts
    mqtt_name: pv_voltage_2
    help: PV voltage, string 2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_voltage_string3_volts
    mqtt_name: pv_voltage_3
    help: PV voltage, string 3
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_current_string1_amps
    mqtt_name: pv_current_1
    help: PV current, string 1
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_current_string2_amps
    mqtt_name: pv_current_2
    help: PV current, string 2
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_pv_current_string3_amps
    mqtt_name: pv_current_3
    help: PV current, string 3
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_generator_power_watts
    mqtt_name: generator_power
    help: Generator input power
    type: gauge
  # the two inverter settings the runtime estimate depends on
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_stop_battery_discharge_capacity_percent
    mqtt_name: stop_battery_discharge_capacity
    help: SoC at which the inverter stops discharging the battery
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_inverter_output_shutdown_capacity_percent
    mqtt_name: output_shutdown_capacity
    help: SoC at which the inverter shuts its output down
    type: gauge
  # the Pi itself and the forecast
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_system_cpu_temperature_fahrenheit
    mqtt_name: cpu_temperature
    help: SolarAssistant Pi CPU temperature (Fahrenheit)
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_system_free_storage_megabytes
    mqtt_name: free_storage
    help: SolarAssistant Pi free storage
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_weather_pv_power_predicted_watts
    mqtt_name: pv_power_predicted
    help: Forecast PV power right now
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_weather_pv_energy_remaining_today_kwh
    mqtt_name: pv_energy_remaining_today
    help: Forecast PV energy still to come today
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_weather_cloud_cover_percent
    mqtt_name: cloud_cover
    help: Forecast cloud cover
    type: gauge
  - prom_name: solar_assistant_weather_outside_temperature_fahrenheit
    mqtt_name: outside_temperature
    help: Outside temperature (Fahrenheit)
    type: gauge
